title: Spring Boot 3 Health Response
description: Health status response returned by Spring Boot 3 Actuator /health endpoint. Aggregates all registered HealthIndicator results into a single response.

status.description: Overall application health status aggregated from all health indicators.

components.description: Health status of individual components keyed by component name.

ComponentHealth.title: Component Health
ComponentHealth.description: Health status for a single application component such as database, disk space, or message broker.

details.description: Component-specific health details (database name, validation query, free disk space, etc.).

components.description: Nested sub-component health for composite indicators.
